_about: Combat (RULES.md §9). The table is copied exactly from RULES.md §9.3 [balanced]: each row is a 2d6 roll range, each cell 'A<attacker steps lost> D<defender steps lost>' plus 'R' if the defender retreats. Don't change numbers here without changing RULES.md (and re-running tools/wfsim.py). See docs/DATA.md.

barrageBonus.name: Heavy barrages
barrageBonus.note: The Hundred Days: by 1918 the Allies had the guns and shells to fire far heavier barrages than in 1916.

attackCost._about: IP an attack takes from the paying nation's munitions stockpile (RULES.md §9.1, V2c), on top of any barrage. attackLimit is the most attacks a nation may make in a month (a nation's own attackLimit in nations.json overrides it).

capture._about: Will changes when a named box is captured (RULES.md §11). 'loser' says which nation loses the box's VP in Will (by lane, else the default); 'gain' gives each listed nation a share of the VP, rounded down. 'special' boxes add more on top.
